name: Levi
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: On the third day, when they were sore, two of the sons, Simeon and Levi, took each man his sword, came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males; they took Dinah out, spoiled the city, and carried away the substance and the households.

note.label: Genesis 34: Dinah and the Zeal of Simeon and Levi

points: Some of you have doubt the Haitian is not really Levi. Simeon and Levi are brethren. Now, you notice he say Simeon and Levi are brothers, but the whole 12 is brothers. Why he specifically mention Simeon and Levi? The so-called Haitian and Dominican: map shown, that's the same island. They're divided, but they're in the same island. In other words, at the end, those two going to be together in the same island. One part called Haiti, one part called Dominican Republic.

Be not thou united: guess what, they're not united. One time this used to be one island; now they're divided. One part Simeon, one part Levi. As a matter of fact, they hate each other. Dominicans cannot stand Haitians; Haitians cannot stand Dominicans.

note.label: Know Your Enemy: God's Foes & Ours

points: Simeon and Levi are brethren: in the last days the so-called Haitians and the so-called Dominicans are living on the same island of Hispaniola. Instruments of cruelty are in their habitations: that's going into the witchcraft, the voodoo and black magic. Unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: that's why the Haitians and the Dominicans hate each other and are not united; that's why you see them snatching people off the street and deporting them.

note.label: Judgement! To Hell with Your Reparations!

points: Simeon is the so-called Dominican and Levi the so-called Haitian today. Simeon and Levi are brethren: all the tribes of Israel are brethren, but these two in particular were to dwell together, and they share the same island, Hispaniola.

Instruments of cruelty are in their habitations: the witchcraft practiced on that island, such as the voodoo of Haiti. O my soul, come not thou into their secret: because of those practices the Most High does not unite them, and the two nations stay divided on the island even though Levi helped free Simeon from slavery.

note.label: Genesis 49: What Shall Befall the Twelve Tribes in the Last Days

points: A man of the house of Levi took to wife a daughter of Levi. These are Amram and Jochebed, the father and mother of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

note.label: Exodus 2: The Birth of Moses

points: Moses pressed, Send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send; and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses. Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well; he spoke the Hebrew of the people fluently.

note.label: Exodus 4: The Three Signs and the Covenant of Circumcision

points: Moses stood in the gate of the camp and said, who is on the Lord's side? All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him, and there fell of the people that day about 3,000 men.

note.label: Why They Hated US: Walking in the Footsteps of the Persecuted

points: Moses stood in the gate of the camp and said, Who is on the LORD's side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.

note.label: Exodus 32: The Golden Calf at Horeb

points: Notwithstanding, the cities of the Levites, the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time, for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel. Levi was not given any land; his portion was the offerings of the Lord, and the fields of the suburbs of their cities are their perpetual possession and may not be sold.

note.label: Leviticus 25: The Sabbath of the Land and the Year of Jubile

points: The children of Levi were numbered after the houses of their fathers, by their families. Your lineage is determined by your father, not your mother.
The claim that identity passes through the mother is nowhere in the Bible; number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers is the standard of scripture.

note.label: Numbers 3: The Levites Taken Instead of the Firstborn

points: The test was censers: take you censers, Korah and all his company, put fire therein and incense before the Lord, and the man whom the Lord doth choose, he shall be holy. Ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

note.label: Numbers 16: The Rebellion of Korah

points: On the morrow, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds; and every man took back his own rod.

note.label: Numbers 17: Aaron's Rod That Budded

points: The Lord gave the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance. This is the tithe: the tenth part was given to the Levites for their service which they served, the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, their sacrificing and teaching of the laws.
That tenth went to the children of Levi, and it was done away with when Christ came and died and took that priesthood; we no longer give that tenth to Levi.

note.label: Numbers 18: The Charge and Portion of the Priests and Levites

points: Jochebed the daughter of Levi bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses and Miriam their sister; and unto Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

note.label: Numbers 26: The Second Census of the Families of Israel

points: Among the Levite cities six were set apart for refuge, appointed for the manslayer to flee there, with forty and two more added: forty and eight cities in all, given from every tribe according to its inheritance, many from them that had many and few from them that had few.

note.label: Numbers 35: The Cities of the Levites and the Cities of Refuge

points: At that time the Lord separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant, to stand before the Lord to minister unto him, and to bless in his name; wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren, the Lord is his inheritance.

But they corrupted the covenant of Levi, left off teaching the law, and were partial in it, so the Lord gave them a swift and mighty judgment. Now you understand why Levi, identified in the land of Haiti, has been the poorest in the western hemisphere and catches hell to this day: their provider was the Lord, and they departed out of the way.

note.label: Deuteronomy 10: What Doth the Lord Require of Thee

points: Levi ate well through the sacrifices the Lord set up: the Levites dwelt in the best areas, the suburbs, and lived in castles, because the Lord was their provider. All they had to do was teach Israel the commandments of God.

note.label: Deuteronomy 10: What Doth the Lord Require of Thee

points: Rejoice before the Most High, thou and thy son and thy daughter, thy manservant and thy maidservant, the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow; and remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt.

note.label: Deuteronomy 16: The Three Feasts and Just Judgment

points: Rejoice in thy feast, thou and thy son and thy daughter, thy manservant and thy maidservant, the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow within thy gates.

note.label: Deuteronomy 16: The Three Feasts and Just Judgment

points: The priests the Levites, and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel; they shall eat the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and his inheritance.

note.label: Deuteronomy 18: The Priests' Portion and the Prophet Like Unto Moses

points: If a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the Lord shall choose, then he shall minister in the name of the Lord his God, as all his brethren the Levites do which stand there before the Lord.

note.label: Deuteronomy 18: The Priests' Portion and the Prophet Like Unto Moses

points: The priests the sons of Levi came near, for by their word shall every controversy and every stroke be tried, and the elders of that city washed their hands over the beheaded heifer, answering, our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.

note.label: Deuteronomy 21: The Slain Man, the Firstborn, and the Rebellious Son

points: Moses charged the people that day: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph (which is Ephraim and Manasseh), and Benjamin were to stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people.

note.label: Deuteronomy 27: Write the Law upon Stones

points: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests, the sons of Levi that bear the ark of the covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.

note.label: Deuteronomy 31: Moses' Final Charge and the Rebellion Foretold

points: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one. The Urim and the Thummim were worn in the garment of the high priest, as Exodus 28 lays out; that pertains to the Levites, the lineage of Aaron, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah, in Exodus 17.

note.label: Deuteronomy 33: The Blessing of Moses, Identifying the Tribes in the Last Days

points: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the Lord God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance. The Most High had already said the same thing way back to Aaron, that Levi would have no inheritance in the land but would live among the people, and what was stated back then is being carried out in what we are reading now.

note.label: Joshua 13: Much Land Yet to Be Possessed

points: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the Lord God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them. It is the same thing that is said in verse 14.

note.label: Joshua 13: Much Land Yet to Be Possessed

points: The heads of the fathers of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua, and to the heads of the tribes at Shiloh, because the tribe of Levi had been appointed cities to dwell in with suburbs for their cattle, and the time had come to receive them.

note.label: Joshua 21: The Cities of the Levites

points: When Micah learned the man was a Levite, of the tribe known for the priesthood and the knowledge of the sacrifices, he offered him a deal: dwell with me, be unto me a father and a priest, ten shekels of silver by the year, a suit of apparel, and thy victuals. He hired himself a personal priest for his idols.

note.label: Judges 17: Micah's House of Idols and the Hired Levite

points: The Levite was content to dwell with him and became as one of his sons. Nothing says the Levite was already in idolatry, but when money was offered he went right along with it; being corrupted for reward was always the Levites' weakness.

note.label: Judges 17: Micah's House of Idols and the Hired Levite

points: Then Micah said, now know I that the LORD will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to my priest. A house full of idols and a hired priest over them, yet he expected the Most High to bless him because a Levite was on the payroll. That is how sick in the mind Israel was without leadership.

note.label: Judges 17: Micah's House of Idols and the Hired Levite

points: By the house of Micah they knew the voice of the young man the Levite, and they turned in and questioned him: who brought thee hither? what makest thou in this place? A Levite serving in a house of idols raised questions.

note.label: Judges 18: Dan Steals Micah's Gods and Takes Laish

points: Once more, there was no king in Israel, no leadership structure, still sheep without a shepherd. A certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim took to him a concubine out of Bethlehemjudah; a concubine was a woman dealt with on the level of a servant.

note.label: Judges 19: The Levite's Concubine at Gibeah

points: The twelve sons of Israel are set down: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 2: The Sons of Israel and the Line of Judah

points: The sons of Levi are named, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, and the line runs through Kohath and Amram to Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 6: The Sons of Levi and the Priesthood

points: The sons of Levi are set down again by their families: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, with the sons that came from each.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 6: The Sons of Levi and the Priesthood

points: Joab left Levi and Benjamin uncounted because the king's word was abominable to him.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 21: David Numbers Israel

points: David divided the Levites into courses among the sons of Levi, namely Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, and named their families and their sons in order down the line. He names the father and then names the children, and then names that one's children, going down the line, which is like an inheritance each of them received.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 23: The Numbering and Ordering of the Levites

points: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers, counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the Lord from the age of twenty years and upward. David said the Lord God of Israel had given rest unto his people that they might dwell in Jerusalem forever, so the Levites would no more carry the tabernacle nor any vessels of it.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 23: The Numbering and Ordering of the Levites

points: The rest of the sons of Levi are named after the house of their fathers, family by family, down the line. These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 24: The Divisions and Courses of the Priests

points: When the priests came out of the holy place, the Levite singers, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun with their sons and brethren, stood arrayed in white linen with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, and a hundred and twenty priests sounded with trumpets.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 5: The Ark Brought Into the House and the Glory That Filled It

points: Remember the Levites were scattered throughout all 12 tribes. The ones that lived with the kingdom of Judah were fine, but the ones that lived with the northern kingdom were not, because when the high holy days would come about, Levi's job was to tell everybody, especially in them three top holidays, we have to go up to Jerusalem to worship. Remember what the woman of Samaria said: you Jews say that in Jerusalem is where men ought to worship.

For Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office: they kicked Levi out. We don't want y'all here, cuz y'all trying to get us to do what God says. No, we want to worship idols. And Jeroboam ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.

note.label: Raising Up the Tabernacle of David That Fell

points: The remnant here shows Judah, Benjamin, and Levi with those who had remained. Jeshua and his sons and brethren stand together to oversee the workmen.

note.label: Ezra 3: The Foundation of the Temple Is Laid

points: Ezra gathered the company at the river Ahava, abode three days, and viewing the people found none of the sons of Levi, so he sent men of understanding to Iddo at Casiphia to bring ministers for the house.

note.label: Ezra 8: The Company Returns And Fasts At Ahava

points: By the good hand of the Most High they brought back men of understanding of the sons of Levi and a large number of Nethinims appointed for the service, all expressed by name. Ezra knew which men among him had understanding and called on them.

note.label: Ezra 8: The Company Returns And Fasts At Ahava

points: Only Jonathan and Jahaziah were employed about this matter, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them, so the sin was dealt with in orderly parts.

note.label: Ezra 10: The Covenant to Put Away Strange Wives

points: The tithes of the ground go to the Levites, for the Levite was the one ordained to receive them. A pastor over a church today is most likely not a Levite, so the pattern of who receives the tithe was set by the law, not by the office men give themselves.

note.label: Nehemiah 10: The Sure Covenant Is Sealed

points: The Levites and priests were recorded as chief of the fathers down to the reign of Darius the Persian, and the sons of Levi were written in the book of the chronicles until the days of Johanan.

note.label: Nehemiah 12: The Priests, the Levites, and the Dedication of the Wall

points: Outside the inner gates are the chambers of the singers in the inner court. The chamber facing south is for the priests who keep the charge of the house, and the chamber facing north is for the priests who keep the charge of the altar, the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, who come near the Lord to minister.

note.label: Ezekiel 40: The Vision of the Temple and the Measuring Reed

points: That my covenant might be with Levi, saith the Lord of hosts. God had a covenant with Levi. Levi broke that covenant. Instead of helping the people, Levi brought the people to sin; Levi made the people sin. So God broke the covenant with Levi.

note.label: Know Your Enemy: God's Foes & Ours

points: But ye are departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi. Levi been corrupted. Yes, Levi been corrupted.

The only way this can change: Levi, repent. Come back to the law of God. So you want change in Haiti? Repent. Oh, you don't want that though. That's the only way. We giving you the solution: the solution is repent, come back to the law of God. And it's not only for Levi: I'm talking about Judah, I'm talking about Benjamin, I'm talking about the whole 12 tribes. You want change? Repent. That's the only way.

note.label: Know Your Enemy: God's Foes & Ours

points: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the Lord an offering in righteousness. Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the Lord, as in the days of old, and as in former years.

note.label: We Are Born in Babylon

points: But this is what Most High got for Levi: and he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the Lord an offering in righteousness. That's talking about repentance. Levi might be wicked as hell, but if they repent, they still going to get the kingdom. God is going to bring Levi back.
We all know today the high priest is Christ. You don't have to go to Levi no more; we only go to Christ. Christ is the high priest.

note.label: Know Your Enemy: God's Foes & Ours

cases.name: Simeon and Levi at Shechem
cases.charge: Deceitful covenant; slaughter of a city in their anger
cases.preview: Dinah went out to see the daughters of the land without supervision, and Shechem the prince of the country took her and defiled her.
